text: Acatamathesia (or Akat- ) [Gr. a + kata + maqe î n , to learn]: Ger. Akatamathesie ; Fr. aprosexie (inability to attend); Ital. acatamatesi . Inability to comprehend ordinary conversation, accompanied by a blunting of the perceptions. It appears as a degenerative symptom in various forms of chronic INSANITY (q.v.). ( J.J. )
